Indication role, sensor/input modality, measured phenomenon, and at least one clearly named output are required
Unknown sensor locations are preserved as 'Location not specified' rather than causing exclusion
measurement_counts: chest and abdomen expansion and contraction

output_family_counts: quantitative sleep, breathing and motion parameters
exclusion_reason_counts: no identifiable sensor/input-modality and measured phenomenon
